notes: "I started HUANDENG so that preparing the next lab meeting could begin with what I actually wanted to say. The agent can help organize, build and revise it. The materials, page identity and history stay in the project, and I can return to the same work. This introduction itself grew from my spoken account. What I want to preserve is the human judgment behind the presentation."
